variants.headline: Still in view: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}.

We take a favourable view of {target}. A leadership challenge does not make hostile interpretations correct, and a political position deserves support where the case against it rests on assumption.
